Delta expects $200M profit hit from shutdown, Marvell stock pops
content.description:
Morning Brief host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Delta Air Lines (DAL) expecting a $200 million hit to profit due to flight disruptions tied to the US government shutdown, Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock popping in premarket hours after slightly beating third quarter earnings estimates and announcing a plan to acquire Celestial AI, and American Eagle Outfitters (AEO) shares moving higher on its own earnings beat and strong sales.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.

content.title: American Eagle, Marvell, Softbank: Trending stocks
content.description:
High-street retailers American Eagle (AEO) and Zara owner Inditex see shares surge on earnings beats. Boeing (BA) rival Airbus (AIR.PA) rebounds after a selloff caused by a string of aircraft issues this week. Marvell (MRVL), Softbank (9984.T) and Crowdstrike (CRWD) are some of the tech stocks making big moves this morning - Ramzan Karmali tells you why.

content.title: Why American Eagle (AEO) Stock Is Trading Up Today
content.summary: Shares of young adult apparel retailer American Eagle Outfitters (NYSE:AEO) jumped 14.2% in the afternoon session after the company reported impressive third quarter results that beat analysts' sales, earnings and EBITDA estimates.

content.title: Heard on the Street Recap: Betting on Cuts
content.summary: The Dow industrials added 0.9% and the Nasdaq composite gained 0.2%.  The "modest fall" should be enough to persuade Federal Reserve policymakers to vote for another rate cut next week, said Stephen Brown of Capital Economics.  The retailer’s stock was up 1.8%, a gain that pushed it above the market-cap milestone and made it the 12th U.S. company to surpass it, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
